name: TechnoPro Holdings
h1: Run the AI transformation on one connected layer
lede: TechnoPro is training 10,000 AI implementation engineers and investing in AI-driven development and Delivery DX. Airtable gives the transformation office one view of skills, programmes and integrations across the Group.
why_h2: A new owner, a new AI mandate and an active M&A plan
why_p: Since privatisation, TechnoPro has set out an AI-first strategy with dedicated leadership, significant investment and acquisitions to integrate.

signals.title: Group adopts Claude Enterprise
signals.body: TechnoPro named its Claude Enterprise rollout the first major initiative since privatisation, part of a JPY 10bn-plus AI and DX investment covering 30,000-plus engineers.
signals.angle: Track engineer skills, training progress and assignments across the Group as the rollout scales.

signals.title: AI implementation strategy and M&A plan
signals.body: Blackstone outlined a plan to relist TechnoPro as an AI implementation engineering company, with JPY 10bn for AI infrastructure and about JPY 100bn for M&A.
signals.angle: Coordinate post-merger integration workstreams across acquired consulting, AI and SI firms in one system.

signals.title: Head of AI and CTrO appointed
signals.body: Kotatsu Saito became Executive Officer and Head of AI and Yoichi Ouchi Executive Officer and CTrO, effective 1 January 2026.
signals.angle: Give the AI and transformation offices one view of programme status across business units.

signals.title: Delisted following Blackstone tender offer
signals.body: TechnoPro shares were delisted from the Tokyo Stock Exchange on 9 December 2025 after Blackstone's tender offer and share consolidation.
signals.angle: Build the operational visibility a future relisting will demand, starting now.
signals.src: TechnoPro Holdings and Japan Exchange Group, Dec 2025
